title: Grill with docs
summary: Interviews you relentlessly to sharpen a plan or design, writing ADRs and a glossary as you go.
details: Invoking grill-with-docs starts a relentless interview that sharpens a plan or design while writing docs as you go: it calls both the grilling and the domain-modeling skills, so ADRs and glossary entries come out of the session. It suits anyone who wants their thinking stress-tested and the decisions recorded in the repo. It adds a skill folder that only you can start and that loads only when used; instructions only, so no code runs on its own.
trigger: Type /grill-with-docs with the plan or idea to stress-test.
risk: Instructions only; loads when used. No code runs on its own.
